description.en: Google Antigravity provider. The gateway folds every client dialect — text and image alike — onto the gemini arm; the plugin keeps only the Code Assist v1internal envelope and the token-count verb.
description.zh: Google Antigravity Provider。文本与图像方言均由网关折到 gemini 臂,插件只保留 Code Assist v1internal 包装与 token 计数动词。
